reports.title: Stock Yards Bancorp Reports Record Third Quarter Earnings of $43.5 Million or $1.40 per Diluted Share

lines: The provision for credit losses on loans(1) was $700,000 for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.6 million for the prior year quarter, due to solid organic loan growth for the quarter, strong credit quality metrics and an improved unemployment forecast during the quarter.
